description: This file defines a PHP client class for interacting with the AWS IoT Secure Tunneling service, including method signatures for various tunnel operations and their asynchronous equivalents.

classes.name: IoTSecureTunnelingClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS IoT Secure Tunneling, extending the generic AwsClient to include methods specific to the IoT Secure Tunneling service.

methods.name: describeTunnel
methods.description: Provides details about a specific tunnel.

methods.name: describeTunnelAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously provides details about a specific tunnel.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: rotateTunnelAccessToken
methods.description: Rotates the access token for a tunnel.

methods.name: rotateTunnelAccessTokenAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously rotates the tunnel's access token.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
